row: Join Dr. Seth Bynum, avid bird hunter, outdoorsman, photographer and veterinarian on his adventures afield.  Seth is an Idaho-based veterinarian with an interest in animal reproduction and breeding.  He is a North Carolina native and has lived in Montana, Washington and now the panhandle of Idaho.  He practices at Lewiston Veterinary Clinic in Lewiston, ID.  His two German shorthaired pointers, River and Shine, accompany him on his trips around the Northwest.
